title: Determination 45/1/191: fire-resistance period of the structure of a 39-storey tower (Requirement B3, 1991 regulations)
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 1991 (as amended, up to and including SI 1999/77): Requirement B3 (internal fire spread, structure)

facts.text: The proposal is a 179.8 m high free-standing steel-framed tower with 39 storeys plus mezzanine above ground and one basement level, circular in plan.
The site is described as densely populated and busy city-centre.
The question concerns Requirement B3 (internal fire spread, structure) and the period of fire resistance of a major element of the structure.
Determination: the Secretary of State concluded that the proposals do not comply with Requirement B3 (internal fire spread, structure).
The determination records that the Secretary of State weighed the particular need to ensure the safety of persons in and about the proposed building.
